scripts.postinstall: node -e "try{const fs=require('fs');const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json','utf8'));const n=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('node_modules/next/package.json','utf8'));console.log('TSOP build probe => app '+p.version+' | next '+n.version)}catch(e){console.log('TSOP build probe => next not resolvable')}"
